title: Normalized tensor reindexing preserves the specified signed braiding
statement: For a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, at any finite or completed coefficient stage, let c be the recorded Hom/tensor reindexing comparison and let β_X, β_Y be the specified signed tensor braidings for its closed structures and tensor models. For arbitrary unbounded derived objects M,N, F(β_Y(M,N));c.tensor(N,M)=c.tensor(M,N);β_X(FM,FN). No constructibility or completeness of M,N is assumed.

proof.text: On simultaneous K-flat representatives, both composites send each homogeneous x tensor y to the exchanged reindexed generators with sign (-1)^(pq). The comparison tensor_model and the braiding localization models descend the chain equality. K-flat resolutions of arbitrary inputs give localization isomorphisms; naturality of both tensor comparisons and braidings transports the square along them.

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingOrdinaryBraiding {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY) (M N : podReindexingDerived l E Y s) :
    let F := podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s
    let βY := pullbackTensorBraiding (ProEt.topology Y) (podReindexingRing l E Y s) SY TY
    let βX := pullbackTensorBraiding (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X s) SX TX
    F.map (βY.app (M, N)).hom ≫ c.tensor.hom.app (N, M) =
      c.tensor.hom.app (M, N) ≫ (βX.app (F.obj M, F.obj N)).hom
